Short title, extent and commencement

ACT I OF 2004
ACT I OF 2004
NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL ACT, 2004
An Act to provide for the establishment of National Security Council
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th April, 2004]
No.F.9(5)/2004-Legis., dated 20-4-2004.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on 19th
April, 2004, is hereby published for general information:--
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title, extent and commencement.--(1) This Act may be
called the National Security Council Act, 2004.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Definitions

ACT I OF 2004
ACT I OF 2004
NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL ACT, 2004
An Act to provide for the establishment of National Security Council

No.F.9(5)/2004-Legis., dated 20-4-2004.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on 19th
April, 2004, is hereby published for general information:--
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
2. Definitions.---In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant
in the subject or context,--
(A)
"Chairman" means the Chairman of the Council;
(b)
"Council" means the National Security Council established under
section 3;
(c)
"Government" means the Federal Government or a Provincial Government,
as the case may be;
(d)
"President" means the President of the Islamic Republic of, Pakistan;
and
(e)
"Rules" means the rules made under this Act

Establishment of National Security Council

ACT I OF 2004
ACT I OF 2004
NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL ACT, 2004
An Act to provide for the establishment of National Security Council
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th April, 2004]
No.F.9(5)/2004-Legis., dated 20-4-2004.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on 19th
April, 2004, is hereby published for general information:--
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
3. Establishment of National Security Council.--There shall be
established a National Security Council to serve as a forum for consultation on
matters of national security including the sovereignty, integrity; defence,
security of the State and crisis management.

Composition

ACT I OF 2004
ACT I OF 2004
NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL ACT, 2004
An Act to provide for the establishment of National Security Council
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th April, 2004]
No.F.9(5)/2004-Legis., dated 20-4-2004.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on 19th
April, 2004, is hereby published for general information:--
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
4. Composition.--The President shall be the Chairman of the Council
and its other members shall be the Prime Minister, the Chairman of the Senate,
the Speaker of the National Assembly, the Leader of the Opposition in the
National Assembly, the Chief Ministers of the Provinces, the Chairman Joint
Chiefs of Staff Committee and the Chiefs of Staff of the Pakistan Army,
Pakistan Navy and Pakistan Air Force.

Functions of the Council

ACT I OF 2004
ACT I OF 2004
NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL ACT, 2004
An Act to provide for the establishment of National Security Council
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th April, 2004]
No.F.9(5)/2004-Legis., dated 20-4-2004.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on 19th
April, 2004, is hereby published for general information:--
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
5. Functions of the Council.--(1) The Council shall serve as a
forum for consultation to the President and the Government on matters of
national security including the sovereignty, integrity, defence, security of
the State and crisis management.
(2) The Council shall formulate
and make recommendations to the President and the Government in accordance with
the consultations in terms of subsection (1).
(3) Any proposal on an issue
deemed to be of national importance which requires implementation, shall be
referred by the Council to the National Assembly or the Senate for appropriate
action.

Meetings

ACT I OF 2004
NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL ACT, 2004
An Act to provide for the establishment of National Security Council
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th April, 2004]
No.F.9(5)/2004-Legis., dated 20-4-2004.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on 19th
April, 2004, is hereby published for general information:--
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
6. Meetings.--(1) The meetings of the Council may be convened by
the President either in his discretion or on the advice of the Prime Minister.
(2) A meeting of the Council may
be called notwithstanding a vacancy in the office of one or more members of the
Council.
(3) a meeting of the Council,
once called, may not be absence of anyone or more of its members.
(4) The Council may invite any
person to attend any of its meetings, by special invitation.

National Security Council Secretariat

It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
7. National Security Council Secretariat.--(1) There shall be a
Secretary of the Council who shall be appointed by the Chairman on such terms
and conditions as may be determined by the Chairman.
(2) The Secret4ry shall be the
head of the Secretariat and shall have such other powers and functions as may
be conferred on him by the Rules:
Provided that till such time that
the rules are made the Secretary may, with the approval of the Chairman,-
(a) exercise
such powers and perform such functions as may be necessary for carrying out the
purposes of this Act and the functioning of the Council; and
(b) appoint
officers and staff to be employed in connection with the functions of the
Council and determine their terms and conditions of employment.

8. Power to make rules.--The Council may, by notification in the
official Gazette, make rules for carrying out the purposes of this Act:
Provided that till such time that
the rules are made the Council ma with the approval of the Chairman, follow
such procedure as it may fit.
